findings.suggestion: Pin exact versions (or remove undici entirely, and drop typescript-plugin-css-modules if CSS modules aren't used — the tsconfig comment at app/tsconfig.json notes this) to avoid silent supply-chain drift

summary: This app sits at the conservative end of the experimentalness scale: zero experimental, preview, RC or canary APIs, all Qwik/Qwik City usage being core stable 1.x APIs. It correctly pins the current stable release (^1.20.3) rather than the in-flight Qwik 2.0.0-rc line. The only static-analysis hit (Vite's preview config) is a false positive from starter boilerplate.
